format: raw RGBA8 output from shape_render_cli; one record per SVG fixture
root_cause: The round-4 mark_varying_shape_bounds path marked every pixel within a gradient or clip shape bbox for 4x4 sampling. This changed established center-sample pixels in the interior. The premerge and committed merge-candidate renderers agree on clip-union, object-bbox-transform, and user-space-transform; removing that blanket mask restores those pixels. The scalar unculled reference now uses the same shared boundary-mask sampling decision while still traversing every shape and edge, so it remains a direct exact-output comparator for the culled renderer.
overpaint_semantics: The remaining 0732b8e difference in gradient-stop-alpha-overpaint is intentional. For one sample in that fixture, 0732b8e replaces the opaque red sample with [0,0,255,128], while the working tree source-overs the 50% blue sample over red to [127,0,128,255].
